kinds.label: Technology
kinds.def: You install it, run it, import it, or subscribe to it. Products, libraries, servers, CLIs, managed services.

kinds.label: API symbol
kinds.def: A named symbol inside a language, framework, or library: annotation, class, method, flag, env var, config key, endpoint. Belongs to a product; is not itself one.

kinds.label: Protocol / format
kinds.def: A protocol, wire format, file format, or published standard. Has implementations but is not one.

kinds.label: Model
kinds.def: A trained model, model family, or hosted model endpoint you call or download.

kinds.label: Benchmark / dataset
kinds.def: An evaluation benchmark or a corpus. Not the harness that runs it (that is tech).

kinds.label: Concept / pattern
kinds.def: A pattern, algorithm, principle, or technique with no shipped artifact.

Redis.s: In-memory key-value server used as distributed cache, session/token store, rate-limit counter, and pub/sub bus.

Langfuse.s: Open-source, self-hostable LLM observability: traces, cost per call, prompt versioning, scores and eval runs.

HashiCorp Vault.s: Central secrets manager with dynamic short-lived credentials, key rotation, PKI issuance and transit encryption.

Debezium.s: Change-data-capture connector that tails a database's replication log and publishes row changes to Kafka.

CatBoost.s: Gradient-boosted decision trees with ordered boosting and native categorical handling; strong on tabular data.

Ray Tune.s: Distributed hyperparameter search on Ray with ASHA, HyperBand and PBT schedulers; plugs into most trackers.

DeepSpeed.s: PyTorch training library whose ZeRO sharding and CPU/NVMe offload fit models too large for one GPU's memory.

ONNX Runtime.s: Cross-platform runtime that executes and optimizes ONNX graphs on CPU, GPU and edge, with quantization APIs.

Axon Framework.s: Java CQRS and event-sourcing framework with a command bus, event-sourced aggregates and saga orchestration.

LangChain.s: General LLM app framework: LCEL pipelines, prompt templates, retrievers and create_agent tool-calling loops.

SonarQube.s: Static-analysis server that gates a build on code smells, complexity, duplication and SAST security findings.

Conductor OSS.s: JSON-DSL workflow engine for long-running orchestration and sagas; Netflix-created, now stewarded by Orkes.

Flyway.s: Versioned SQL schema migration tool that applies ordered scripts and records them in a history table.

KEDA.s: Kubernetes autoscaler that scales workloads (to zero) off event sources like Kafka lag or queue depth.

pgstattuple.s: PostgreSQL extension that measures real table and index bloat: dead-tuple percentage and page fill factor.

TF Serving.s: TensorFlow's production model server: loads SavedModels, serves gRPC/REST, and handles versioning and A/B routing.

Anthropic tool use.s: Claude's function-calling interface: JSON tool schemas the model selects and fills, plus constrained outputs.

Celery.s: Python distributed task queue running background jobs over Redis/RabbitMQ/SQS with retries and scheduling.

dig.s: Command-line DNS lookup tool that shows the full resolution chain, record types and TTLs.

GraalVM native-image.s: Ahead-of-time compiler that turns a JVM application into a self-contained native binary with fast startup.

java.util.ServiceLoader.s: JDK service-discovery mechanism that loads implementations declared in META-INF/services or a module descriptor.

line_profiler.s: Line-by-line CPU profiler for Python functions; shows per-line hit counts and time at 3-5x slowdown.

NVIDIA Nsight Systems.s: System-wide GPU timeline profiler showing kernels, memcopies, NVTX ranges and CPU-GPU gaps.

Portkey.s: Managed LLM gateway giving one endpoint over many providers with routing, fallback, caching and cost tracing.

safetensors.s: Tensor serialization format that loads weights zero-copy and cannot execute code, unlike pickled .bin/.pt files.

Statsig.s: Experimentation platform for feature flags and A/B tests with automated metric readouts.

YugabyteDB.s: Distributed SQL database with a PostgreSQL-compatible wire protocol, Raft replication and built-in 2PC.

aiosqlite.s: Async SQLite driver for asyncio; zero-config in-memory database for fast tests.

argon2-cffi.s: Python binding for Argon2id password hashing with tunable memory, time and parallelism cost.

AWS SQS/SNS.s: AWS managed queue (SQS) and pub/sub fan-out (SNS) for async messaging between services.

Byte Buddy.s: Typed DSL for generating and subclassing Java classes at runtime or build time; the engine behind Mockito.

CloudFront.s: AWS CDN that caches HTTP responses at edge PoPs and terminates TLS, WAF and edge compute there.

controller-runtime.s: Go library for writing Kubernetes controllers and operators: reconcile loops, caches, CRD scaffolding.

cudaStreamSynchronize.s: CUDA call that blocks the host until one stream's queued work finishes, surfacing any deferred kernel errors.

Django REST Framework.s: REST toolkit for Django: serializers, ViewSets and routers over Django models.

EXPLAIN ANALYZE.s: SQL command that runs a query and prints the execution plan with real row counts and per-node timing.

GAIA benchmark.s: 466-task benchmark for generalist agents across three difficulty levels, scoring multi-step tool-use reasoning.

gunicorn.s: Pre-fork WSGI process supervisor; runs FastAPI/ASGI apps via UvicornWorker across multiple worker processes.

hypopg.s: PostgreSQL extension that creates hypothetical indexes so EXPLAIN can price them without building them.

Java Flight Recorder.s: Low-overhead JVM event recorder for continuous production profiling: allocation, locks, GC and I/O events.

JDBC.s: Java's standard database API: one interface, many vendor drivers chosen at runtime by URL and classpath.

JWT.s: Signed, self-contained token format carrying claims; the usual bearer credential for stateless API auth.

LangMem.s: Long-term agent memory for LangChain: stores reflections and retrieves them by recency and importance.

Logstash.s: Log ingestion pipeline that collects, parses and transforms events before shipping them to Elasticsearch.

Microsoft Teams.s: Chat platform used as the incident war room and notification channel, with bots wiring alerts into threads.

Netflix DGS.s: Netflix's Spring Boot GraphQL framework: annotation-driven data fetchers, codegen and federation support.

Objects.hash.s: JDK helper that composes a null-safe hashCode from several fields, matching an equals implementation.

openssl s_client.s: OpenSSL CLI that opens a TLS connection and dumps the handshake, cipher, certificate chain and expiry.

pg_stat_user_tables.s: PostgreSQL catalog view of per-table activity: dead tuples, autovacuum timing and scan counts for bloat triage.

protoc-gen-grpc-java.s: protoc plugin that generates Java gRPC service stubs and clients from .proto definitions.

R2DBC.s: Reactive relational database API for the JVM: non-blocking, backpressure-aware SQL access for WebFlux.

Resilience4j RateLimiter.s: In-process rate limiter for Java services, composable with Resilience4j retry, bulkhead and circuit breaker.

Sentinel.s: Name shared by two products: Alibaba's Java flow-control/circuit-breaking library and HashiCorp's policy DSL.

Spring Cloud Stream.s: Spring binder abstraction that writes messaging code once and binds it to Kafka, RabbitMQ, Kinesis or Service Bus.

State.s: Behavioral pattern where an object changes behavior by swapping state objects instead of branching on a flag.

Tekton.s: Kubernetes-native CI/CD: pipelines and reusable Tasks modeled as CRDs, each step running in its own pod.

TimescaleDB.s: PostgreSQL extension for time-series data: hypertable partitioning, native compression and continuous aggregates.

Traefik.s: L7 reverse proxy and load balancer that discovers routes dynamically from Docker and Kubernetes labels.

Vault.s: HashiCorp's secrets store for credentials, signing keys and PKI, with dynamic leases and audited access.

wscat.s: Command-line WebSocket client for connecting to and poking a raw WebSocket endpoint by hand.

@Argument.s: Spring GraphQL annotation binding a GraphQL field argument to a controller method parameter.

@ConditionalOnProperty.s: Spring Boot condition that registers a bean only when a configuration property has a given value.

@EnableScheduling.s: Spring annotation that turns on the scheduling infrastructure backing @Scheduled methods.

@mastra/pg.s: Mastra's PostgreSQL adapter, using pgvector as the vector store and memory backend for TypeScript agents.

@Pointcut.s: Spring AOP annotation declaring a named, reusable pointcut expression that advice methods can reference.

@SpringIntegrationTest.s: Spring Integration test annotation that boots the integration context with endpoints under test control.

abc.s: Python stdlib module for abstract base classes; @abstractmethod enforces hook contracts at instantiation.

adk eval.s: Google ADK CLI that replays an evalset of test conversations against trajectory and response-match criteria.

agent_as_tool.s: Pattern exposing a whole sub-agent as a callable tool, so one agent can delegate without a handoff.

aioitertools.s: Async counterparts of itertools for async generators; used to build streaming asyncio pipelines.

Alpaca-Cleaned.s: Quality-filtered version of the 52K-example Alpaca instruction dataset, used for supervised fine-tuning.

anext.s: Python builtin that advances an async iterator, the await-able counterpart of next().

Anthropic Computer Use.s: Claude tool that drives a real screen: the model sees a screenshot and returns mouse/keyboard actions.

AopUtils.isAopProxy.s: Spring utility that reports whether a given object is an AOP proxy rather than the raw target bean.

Apache Pekko (or Akka) actors.s: JVM actor toolkit: single-threaded actors with mailboxes and supervision hierarchies for message-passing concurrency.

ApplicationModules.verify.s: Spring Modulith check that fails a test when code crosses a module boundary it is not allowed to cross.

ArrayDeque.s: Resizable circular-array deque; the preferred JDK stack and queue implementation over Stack and LinkedList.

AspectJProxyFactory.s: Spring factory that wraps a plain object in an AOP proxy programmatically, handy for unit-testing pointcuts.

asyncmy.s: Actively maintained async MySQL/MariaDB driver for asyncio and SQLAlchemy's async engine.

AutoDAN.s: Reference implementation of genetic-algorithm jailbreak search, used to red-team model refusal behavior.

awesome-mcp-servers.s: Community-curated catalogue of Model Context Protocol servers, used to find an existing server before writing one.

AWS ECR.s: AWS-managed OCI container registry with IAM-based access control, image scanning on push and lifecycle rules.

AWS RDS Automated.s: RDS/Aurora managed backups giving point-in-time recovery with up to 35 days of retention.

AWS WAF.s: AWS web application firewall: managed and custom rules blocking common attack patterns at the edge.

Azure Load Balancer.s: Azure's regional L4 load balancer distributing TCP/UDP flows across backend VMs and scale sets.

bandit.s: Python SAST linter that flags shell=True, pickle.loads, hardcoded passwords and other insecure code patterns.

Benchmarks.s: Umbrella entry for tool-use benchmark suites such as ToolBench, API-Bank and ToolAlpaca.

Blackbox exporter.s: Prometheus exporter that probes endpoints over HTTP, TCP, ICMP or DNS to produce black-box availability SLIs.

brotli.s: Lossless compression format for HTTP content encoding; better ratios than gzip on text at similar speed.

Bytecode Viewer.s: GUI tool that decompiles and edits Java class files so you can inspect the bytecode the compiler emitted.

Capacity/forecast tools.s: Umbrella entry for demand-forecasting tooling used in capacity planning against SLO headroom.

cgroups cpu.cfs_quota_us.s: Linux cgroup knob setting a hard CPU ceiling per scheduling period; what Docker --cpus writes underneath.

ChatDev.s: Research multi-agent framework simulating a software company, with role-playing agents in a waterfall pipeline.

circuit-breaker tooling.s: Representation-engineering defence that ablates harmful internal directions rather than filtering the output text.

Claude Desktop config.s: claude_desktop_config.json, the file that declares which MCP servers Claude Desktop launches and with what args.

Cline.s: Open-source VS Code coding agent that plans, edits files and runs commands using a model you choose.

CloudHealth.s: Third-party FinOps platform for multi-cloud cost visibility, allocation, and pre-deploy IaC cost estimates.

Cohere Rerank 3.5.s: Managed cross-encoder reranker that rescores retrieved passages; 100+ languages and a 4096-token context.

community SYCL backends.s: SYCL-for-CUDA and SYCL-for-HIP plugins that let one SYCL source target NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, not just Intel.

ConfigurableBeanFactory.s: Spring's configurable bean-factory interface for programmatic bean lookup and scope registration.

ContentNegotiatingViewResolver.s: Spring MVC resolver that picks the view or message converter to use based on the request's Accept header.

Coq.s: Proof assistant for machine-checked mathematics; used to verify inductive proofs about algorithms.

CPython ast module.s: Python stdlib module that parses source into Python's own abstract syntax tree for inspection or rewriting.

CSI snapshot controller.s: Kubernetes controller implementing VolumeSnapshot: point-in-time snapshots and restores of CSI volumes.
